```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Libraries

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(mapview)

source("ITU_R_Predictions/Functions/get_dhmv_wcs.R")

### Simple things to change as inputs

# Study area
sa <- read.csv("ITU_R_Predictions/Input/study_area.csv") %>%
  filter(name == "MERELBEKE") # Choose which gateway location to simulate for

# Distance for the simulation (in meter and currently minimally 2000)
sim_dist <- 5000

```

```{r height models}

# transform to SF
sa_sf <- st_as_sf(
  sa,
  coords = c("lon","lat"),
  crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 31370) %>%
  # Radius of 5 km
  st_buffer(dist = sim_dist)

# Create bbox around study area
bbox_data <- sa_sf %>%
  st_bbox()

# Digital Terrain Model
dtm <- get_dhmv_wcs_tiled(
  "DHMVII_DTM_1m", 
  bbox_data,
  resolution = 1,
  tile_size = 2000)

# Digital Surface Model
dsm <- get_dhmv_wcs_tiled(
  "DHMVII_DSM_1m", 
  bbox_data,
  resolution = 1,
  tile_size = 2000)

# Biologische WaarderingsKaart
bwk <- read_sf(
  paste0(
    "https://geo.api.vlaanderen.be/BWK/wfs?",
    "service=WFS&version=1.1.0&request=GetFeature",
    "&typeName=BWK:Bwkhab",
    "&outputFormat=application/json",
    "&srsName=EPSG:31370",
    "&bbox=", paste(bbox_data[c("xmin","ymin","xmax","ymax")], collapse = ","), ",EPSG:31370"
  )
)

# mapview(dtm)
plot(dtm)
plot(st_centroid(sa_sf), add = T)
```

# Make new bwk heights file

```{r bwk calibrated}

# Calculate difference height between dsm and dtm
hdm <- dsm - dtm
hdm[hdm < 0] <- 0 # make lowest value 0

# Crop bkw to bbox of nphk
bwk_height_prep <- st_crop(bwk, bbox_data)

# Extract 90 percentile height for every polygon in the bwk data
bwk_heights <- terra::extract(hdm, vect(bwk_height_prep), fun = function(x) max(x, na.rm=TRUE))

# Assign each polygon with the respective 90 percentile height
bwk_height_prep$calib_h <- bwk_heights[,2]
bwk_height_prep$calib_h[is.na(bwk_height_prep$calib_h)] <- 0 # Fill empty with 0

```

# Save data

```{r save data}

# Save 
st_write(bwk_height_prep, "ITU_R_Predictions/Py1812-main/data/bwk_calibrated.gpkg",
         append = F)

```
